method.input: All markets have timestamps 0..127 and every admission batch uses visible_ts=63; each batch reads one distinct instrument mark from the shared snapshot.
method.parity: Before timing, repeated snapshot construction is checked for equality across all batches; both timed paths use the same partition_point-based snapshot builder and consume the same mark for each market.
method.baseline: Rebuild the full BTreeMap<InstrumentId, Price> for every admission batch, matching the pre-cache repeated assembly path.
method.candidate: Check the cached visible_ts for each batch and build the snapshot once, then reuse the same map for subsequent batches with that timestamp, matching the production cache behavior.
method.timing_scope: Snapshot preparation and mark lookup only; excludes strategy, admission checks, ledger valuation, matching, I/O, and complete backtest orchestration.

limitations: This is a synthetic component microbenchmark for aligned markets; it does not establish end-to-end multi-market or A-share backtest speedup.
The benchmark exercises a high-reuse case where every admission batch has the same visible timestamp; irregular visible timestamps may reuse less often.
No allocator counter was enabled, and the nine product profile measurement statuses are unchanged.
